agent sessions hold ZERO forge credentials today (FORGEJO_* absent; the forgejo-token Bitwarden item is dev-cluster-only and points at the DEV forge) — reads work unauthenticated because the repo is public, writes need an owner-minted PAT first

label writes are permitted from a non-admin write:issue token at this tag, but GET /labels is [] on BOTH instances despite renovate.json asking for `dependencies`, and a labels= filter naming a missing label silently returns unfiltered results -> a per-card label would fail silently. REJECTED.

canonical link instead: branch name (= the slug, already law) read back via the zero-write live-proven GET /pulls/{base}/{head}, plus a `Card:` commit trailer (survives squash-merge, needs no API) and a PR-body footer carrying the card _id. the webhook drop holds for Forgejo too: outbound-only, reqAdmin()-gated, default ALLOWED_HOST_LIST=external refuses an in-cluster receiver, 5s timeout, no retry knobs at this tag; the polling shape is GET /issues?state=all&type=pulls&since= (covers issues AND PRs in one cheap call; /pulls alone has no since)

done.headline: All five escalated unknowns settled against the LIVE build (opencode v2.3.2 + OpenChamber 2.8.0), not docs pinned to v2.1.4.
facts: an awaiting question IS durable data: the question tool creates a Form (metadata.kind==="question"), readable at GET /api/session/:id/form with state.status==="pending"; form.created/replied/cancelled fire, but events are volatile-by-contract so the durable form read is the truth

the 15-minute clock keys off the form's created stamp; a pending question keeps the session busy/active forever and never self-times-out (exactly the ticket's premise, and the answer to review risk B1)
GET /api/session/active WORKS on v2.3.2 (refutes cf-50 and this run's own EXPLORE-session-api finding) — but is process-local per R4

turn-end signal = session.execution.succeeded/failed/interrupted + leaving the active map + terminal outcome + time.idle; session.idle/session.status exist but did NOT fire viewer-less, so do not depend on them
POST /api/session {agent, model:{providerID,id,variant?}, location:{directory}, metadata, title} -> {data:{id}}, metadata survives; POST /api/session/:id/prompt runs unattended (proven to completion)

session.updated is decomposed into session.metadata.updated / renamed / archived / unarchived / viewed; archive state is time.archived (epoch-ms), not a top-level boolean, and needs ?archived=true to read back
objective-met is NOT a session field: authoritative signal is the card sitting in Review/Finished; opt-in corroborators are openchamber.goal.status==="complete" and work.state==="done"
